subject: general
question: What type of satellite is APPLE?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Communication satellite**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **APPLE (Ariane Passenger Payload Experiment)** was India's first experimental communication satellite.
 
• It was launched by the European Space Agency's Ariane-1 rocket on **19 June 1981**.
 
• APPLE marked India's entry into the field of space-based communication.
 
• The satellite was used to demonstrate the capabilities of using satellites for telecommunication and broadcasting services in India.
 
• The success of APPLE paved the way for subsequent Indian communication satellites such as INSAT and GSAT series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Communication satellites** are artificial satellites that relay and amplify radio telecommunications signals via a transponder.
 
• They create a communication channel between a source transmitter and a receiver at different locations on Earth.
 
• These satellites are used for various applications including television broadcasting, internet services, and military communications.
 
• India's space agency, ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation), has developed a series of communication satellites to enhance the country's telecommunication infrastructure.
 
• The success of APPLE significantly contributed to the development of India's satellite communication capabilities and self-reliance in space technology.
